sections.text_helper: Section 28.3.8 "FDCAN Rx FIFO element" in chapter 28 (FD controller area network (FDCAN)), RM0490 Rev 6, page 913.
sections.section_content:
Two Rx FIFOs are configured in the message RAM. Each Rx FIFO section can be
configured to store up to three received messages. The structure of an Rx FIFO element is
described in Table 144. The description is provided in Table 145.
[Table 144. Rx FIFO element]
The element size configured for storage of CAN FD messages is set to 64-byte data field.
[Table 145. Rx FIFO element description]
